divergence_points.reasoning: [Externally authored untrusted content] The land page's behaviour statements are accurate: trunk sync is nonfatal (land.py:201-205, 315-347); named cleanup never syncs (612-640); sweep fetches and prunes even without a token (654); a matching token is revalidated per branch (742-749).
